_metadata.description: Requirements derived from the P2 operational targets in PRD.md.

requirements.title: Platform API executors
requirements.description: Executes actions through official platform APIs where one exists and the identity qualifies for the required access tier. Cleanest and most durable of the three executors, but narrow — most platforms expose posting and little of the engagement vocabulary warming depends on, and access tiers change without notice. Never the assumed path.

validation.notes: An API-executed action produces a record identical in shape to the manual and browser executors.
An action kind with no API coverage on a platform falls back to the configured executor rather than failing.

requirements.title: Cannibalization detection
requirements.description: Detects audience overlap across persona identities operating in the same niche, which the channel canon already records as a real risk when multiple persona accounts run the same slate. Reports overlap as evidence for an operator decision; it does not retire or repoint an identity on its own.

validation.notes: Overlap above the configured threshold produces an advisory record naming both identities and the evidence.

requirements.title: Window optimization
requirements.description: Proposes posting windows derived from an identity's observed reach rather than from a declared window. A proposal only — accepting it edits the program descriptor through the normal validated path, so an optimizer can never silently rewrite a warming program.

validation.notes: A window proposal is produced as a record and does not mutate the active program until accepted.
A proposal derived from fewer than the configured minimum observations is withheld rather than emitted.

requirements.title: Multi-operator handoff
requirements.description: Assigns manual actions to a named operator and tracks completion per assignee, so that manual execution scales past one person without two operators performing the same action on one identity.

validation.notes: An assigned action appears only in the assignee's due list and cannot be completed twice.

requirements.title: Deliberate re-release
requirements.description: Releases a previously published draft again as a distinct release with its own record. For a team producing little, recycling proven material is how cadence is held without producing more — and cadence is the binding constraint long before content quality is. The boundary stays intact: content-desk decides which draft is eligible for re-release and re-approves it; this scenario schedules and records the new release.

validation.notes: A deliberate re-release creates a second release record with its own post id, while a retry of the original release still returns the original result. The idempotency key must distinguish 'retry of release X' from 'new release of draft Y' — CHANMGR-P0-014 asserts the retry half and this asserts the other.
A re-release is refused when the identity's asset-uniqueness constraint would be violated by republishing the same media.
Re-release requires an explicit approval reference from content-desk; a release cannot be repeated on this scenario's own initiative.
